from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
source = Path('products/services/catalogue-google-group-id-delivery/raw/google-products-common-v1.proto')
raw = source.read_bytes()
lines = raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
fields = []
for index, line in enumerate(lines):
    if not re.match(r'^\s*(?:optional\s+)?string\s+item_group_id\s*=', line):
        continue
    start = index
    while start > 0 and lines[start - 1].lstrip().startswith('//'):
        start -= 1
    fields.append({'start_line': start + 1, 'field_line': index + 1, 'verbatim': '\n'.join(lines[start:index + 1])})
result = {'source_url': 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleapis/googleapis/master/google/shopping/merchant/products/v1/products_common.proto', 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'expected_sha256': '33292e48e4e5ebd4a9146b6f3bda2583f8e8cb69341b9ed789ce8273124e5304', 'field_declarations_with_comments': fields, 'scope': 'Merchant API schema. Field comments do not demonstrate acceptance of a submitted feed.'}
result['capture_hash_matches'] = result['source_sha256'] == result['expected_sha256']
output = source.parent.parent / 'merchant-api-field-evidence.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
